summary: A small anemonefish from the eastern Indian Ocean and western Pacific, usually orange with three white bars. Wild groups shelter among sea-anemone tentacles, and the dominant fish is female.
nativeRange: Eastern Indian Ocean and western Pacific.

features: Three broad white bars across an orange or reddish-brown body; some populations are black.
White bars and fins have narrow black edges; typically eleven dorsal spines.
Stocky, oval body flattened from side to side.

habitat.description: Sheltered lagoons and reef slopes, where groups occupy host sea anemones.
